explanation: The Apache-2.0 text is unchanged (Copyright 2023 Ray Authors). Appended are licenses for named third-party code. Apache-2.0 covers vtrace, the prometheus exporter, the modin tests, conda_utils and kuberay utils. MIT covers the OpenAI rllib code, clonevirtualenv, tabulate and dacite. BSD-2-Clause covers ARS. BSD-3-Clause covers glog logging.h, pynvml and setproctitle. Every one is on the allowed list, and nothing restricts use.
